text:
maria (marketing-ops): FYI: noticed a jump in unassigned inbound leads this morning. enrichment webhook timed out and left leads unowned. log: `2026-03-23T09:02:10Z hubspot-enrich timeout 15s lead 12345`

tess (revops): is this the 15s window we set?

maria (marketing-ops): yes. some enrich calls do heavy firmographic lookups and exceed 15s. about 120 leads in last 2 hours, ~6 MQLs.

sam (sdr-lead): can we auto-assign somewhere so SDRs see them? right now they sit in unassigned.

tess (revops): quick patch: add fallback owner in HS workflow when enrichment hasn't returned after 15s -> route to SDR_Triage (round-robin). tag property `enrich_timedout=true`.

aj (growth): long term: increase webhook ack to 30s for heavy lookups and add campaign-level observability.

maria (marketing-ops): also add SF connector guard so we don't overwrite owner if fallback was used. snippet: `if hs_owner == 'rr-fallback' and enrich_timedout == true -> skip upsert`

hubspot-bot: Created task WF-1001: "Inbound enrichment fallback" assigned to maria (marketing-ops).

sam (sdr-lead): i'll cover SDR_Triage rota for 24h and monitor volume.

maria (marketing-ops): deploying fallback now. will run a 5% canary for one campaign to check dupes before full rollout.

tess (revops): add alert: enrich_latency > 12s and enrichment_error_rate > 1%.

aj (growth): thanks team. report back in 3 hours with counts. :thumbsup:
